questions.question: Arrange by customer management responsibility, from MOST to LEAST. Which order is correct?

options.why: This is reversed. SaaS has the least responsibility.
Correct. Responsibility decreases from IaaS to SaaS.
IaaS has more responsibility than PaaS.
Responsibility differs significantly between service types.

questions.explanation: IaaS has the most customer responsibility, then PaaS, then SaaS.

questions.scenario: Developers want to deploy a Node.js web application. They do not want to manage virtual machines or operating systems.
questions.question: Which service type should they use?

options.why: IaaS requires managing VMs and OS.
Correct. App Service runs Node.js apps without OS management.
SaaS is a finished application, not a place to deploy your own code.
They would have to manage servers.

questions.explanation: Deploying your own code without managing infrastructure is PaaS.

questions.question: Which service type is the best fit for a company that needs a CRM system and has no developers?

options.why: They would need to install and manage CRM software themselves.
Correct. A SaaS CRM is ready to use.
This requires buying and running hardware.

questions.explanation: Standard business software with no development capacity is SaaS.

questions.question: Match the examples. Which TWO pairings are correct?
questions.explanation: VMs are IaaS, App Service and Azure SQL Database are PaaS, Microsoft 365 is SaaS.
